hfsplus_mounts.description: List of HFS+ volumes to mount using hpmount(1); each item specifies device, mountpoint, and optionally options. All fields are required unless otherwise noted in items schema below.

hfsplus_unmount_all.description: If true, run hpumount -a to unmount all HFS+ volumes during shutdown or cleanup.

hfsplus_check_before_mount.description: If true, run hpfsck(1) on the device before mounting any HFS+ volume.

hfsplus_device.description: Device node to check with hpfsck if hfsplus_check_before_mount is enabled. Ignored otherwise.
